# [Plan] — The CLI discards operator intent: `--dry-run` / `--json` ignored, unknown flags dropped, unrequested state mutations

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #248 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

## 5. Manual Smoke Test Protocol

**Purpose:** reproduce the operator-visible defect end-to-end on the built CLI, then prove each contract holds — including the negative controls that stop a no-op implementation from passing.

**Artifacts:** `artifacts/plans/248-cli-flag-contract/smoke-248.sh` (runner) and `Containerfile.smoke` (image with `git` + `bash`). Both are in this directory.

### 5.1 Preconditions

1. `npm run build` on the host (the bin requires `dist/`).
2. Docker or Podman available.
3. From the repository root:

```bash
podman build -f artifacts/plans/248-cli-flag-contract/Containerfile.smoke \
  -t agyloop-248-smoke .
podman run --rm \
  -v "$PWD:/src:ro" \
  agyloop-248-smoke \
  bash /src/artifacts/plans/248-cli-flag-contract/smoke-248.sh
```

### 5.2 Sandbox rules (non-negotiable)

- The workspace **must** live under `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-248/<case>/ws` — never `/tmp`. The #279/#241 guard refuses state mutations in `/tmp` with `StateStorageError`, so a `/tmp` smoke produces false failures (discovery §3.1).
- The repo copy used by the CLI is `/work`; `smoke-248.sh` bootstraps it from `/src` (tar copy, `node_modules` and `.git` excluded) when `/work/dist` is absent. Build on the host first (`npm run build`) so `/src/dist` exists.
- Every mutating case gets a **fresh** workspace and a fresh git repo.
- The script must never write to `/src` (mounted read-only).

### 5.3 Seed

```bash
seed_ws() { # $1 = case name, $2 = issue (optional)  — illustrative; smoke-248.sh is authoritative
  WS="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-248/$1/ws"; rm -rf "$WS"; mkdir -p "$WS/.agyloop/tasks"; cd "$WS"
  git init -q -b main .; git config user.email t@t.local; git config user.name t
  echo base > base.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm init
  if [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then
    cat > ".agyloop/tasks/$2.json" <<JSON
{"version":"1.0.0","currentStage":"PLAN","mode":"standard","issue":$2,
 "milestoneTitle":null,"baseBranch":"main","worktree":null,"planDir":null,
 "triagePayload":null,"triageDisposition":null,
 "createdAt":"2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z","updatedAt":"2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z",
 "history":[{"stage":"INITIALIZED","timestamp":"2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z"}],
 "pausedAtGate":null,"pausedAtTimestamp":null,"totalHumanWaitMs":0,
 "planRevisionCount":0,"implementToGateLoops":0,"reviewDispatchCount":0}
JSON
  fi
}
tree_hash() {
  if [ ! -d .agyloop ]; then echo absent; return; fi
  ( cd .agyloop && find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r f; do
      printf '%s ' "$f"; sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1
    done ) | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1
}
```

The task checkpoint above is the discovery seed; it round-trips through this build.

### 5.4 Cases and pass criteria

Every case must print `PASS`/`FAIL`; the script exits non-zero if any case fails.

| Row | Invocation | PASS criteria |
|---|---|---|
| **S1** | `reset --issue 888 --dry-run` | exit 0; stdout contains `[dry-run]`; **`tasks/888.json` exists and `tree_hash` unchanged**; stderr empty of errors |
| **S2** | `reset --issue 888` (negative control) | exit 0; `tasks/888.json` **gone** |
| **S3** | `reset --dry-run` (root) | seeded `state.json` exists afterwards; hash unchanged; `[dry-run]` |
| **S4** | `reset --all --dry-run` | root + both task files exist; hash unchanged; `[dry-run]` |
| **S5** | `sync --dry-run` (local bare origin) | `git rev-parse origin/main` identical before/after; `.git/FETCH_HEAD` identical (or still absent); stdout contains `[dry-run]`; no issue close (no `gh` invoked — assert with a `gh` shim that records calls and exits 127; the shim log must be empty) |
| **S6** | `abort --dry-run` (seeded `.git/index.lock` + dirty file) | lock **still present**; `git stash list` empty; dirty file unchanged; stdout contains `[dry-run]`; stdout does **not** contain `✓ Emergency Abort completed` |
| **S7** | `triage implement --dry-run --issue 901` (seed TRIAGE) | `tasks/901.json` hash unchanged; stage still `TRIAGE`; `.worktrees/901` absent; `[dry-run]`; no `✓ State Updated` |
| **S8** | `worktree clean --dry-run` (orphan dir `.worktrees/4242-orphan`) | orphan dir **still exists**; `[dry-run]`; no `✓ Cleaned` |
| **S9** | `worktree prune --dry-run` (prunable registration) | `git worktree list | wc -l` unchanged; `[dry-run]` |
| **S9b** | `worktree prune` (negative control) | the same workspace **without** `--dry-run` drops the prunable registration (count decreases) |
| **S10** | `worktree remove 902 --dry-run` (real worktree) | directory **still exists**; registration count unchanged; `[dry-run]`; no `✓ … detached` |
| **S11** | `critique install --dry-run` and `critique update --dry-run` | **no** `/root/.local/share/critique` created (or, if pre-installed, binary mtime unchanged); `[dry-run]`; no `✓ Successfully installed/updated`. Offline ⇒ exit 1 + a fetch error, still **no writes** (both outcomes pass the no-write assertion) |
| **S12** | `review --issue 905 --verdict-file verdict.md --dry-run` (seed REVIEW) | checkpoint hash unchanged; stdout has `[dry-run]`; **no** `✓ AI Review recorded.`; **no** line `Next Stage`; `Current Stage : [REVIEW]` present |
| **S13** | `implement --dry-run --issue 907` (seed APPROVAL **and** a minimal `artifacts/plans/907-smoke/implementation_plan.md`) | checkpoint hash unchanged; every success line prefixed `[dry-run]`; no bare `✓ Advanced to` |
| **S14** | `reset --dry-runn --issue 888` | exit ≠ 0; stderr contains `Did you mean '--dry-run'?`; checkpoint **still exists + unchanged** |
| **S15** | `next --skip-discoveryy` | exit ≠ 0; stderr suggestion `--skip-discovery`; no `=== CodeLoop: Next Subagent Directive ===` |
| **S16** | `--bogus value status` | exit ≠ 0; stderr names `--bogus`; stderr does **not** contain `Unknown command "value"`; no mutation |
| **S17** | `status --dry-run`, `next --dry-run`, `worktree list --dry-run`, `critique status --dry-run` | each exit ≠ 0; each stderr names `--dry-run`; nothing written |
| **S18** | bare `codeloop` on a COMPLETED checkpoint with `mode: implement`, `updatedAt` old, no descriptor | `tree_hash` identical; `mode` still `implement`; `updatedAt` unchanged; `.worktrees/909` absent; stdout `✓ Pipeline is in [COMPLETED] stage.` |
| **S19** | `halt --issue 777 --reason quota` in an empty workspace | exit ≠ 0; `tasks/777.json` absent; `status` shows **no** `Active Tasks Matrix` and no `#777` |
| **S20** | `triage --json --issue 901 \| jq .` (or `JSON.parse`) | whole stdout parses as one document |
| **S21** | `status --json` | whole stdout parses; `dryRun === false`; `currentStage === "PLAN"` (raw, no ESC); `activeTasks` array present |
| **S22** | `transition --json DISCOVERY` / `commit --json` | exit ≠ 0; stderr names `--json`; stdout not a JSON document |
| **S23** | corrupt checkpoint `{"currentStage":"GARBAGE"}` at `tasks/999.json` | `status --issue 999` exit 1 with `✗ Status failed:`; bare `status` no `Fatal:`; `next/resume/halt/transition/branch-info --issue 999` all exit 1 and stderr start with `✗`; no stack frames (`    at `) |
| **S24** | `resume --json --issue 888` (seeded paused) | payload has `resolvedFromIssue`, `resolvedFromPath`, `dryRun:false`; the human `Task : #888 (<path>)` line is covered by `cli-status-resume-task-scope.test.ts` |
| **S25** | bare `resume` with `tasks/600.json` and `tasks/700.json` both paused at `COMMIT` (equal `updatedAt`) | exit 0; output names `#700` as the other paused task; the resolver selected `#600` (lowest issue on a tie), never `readdirSync` order |

**Negative controls (mandatory):** S2, S9-without-flag (registration count decreases), S10-without-flag (directory gone), S6-without-flag (lock gone), S1-without-flag (`reset` deletes), S18-with-`--dry-run` (still no write). Without these the suite can pass against an implementation that does nothing at all.

### 5.5 Manual review checklist (operator)

- `codeloop --help` names the JSON-supported commands and the `--plan-path` status; no line advertises `--dry-run` for a read-only command.
- `codeloop reset --dry-run --issue 888` output reads like a proposal (`Would clear …`), not a completion.
- `codeloop review --dry-run` never says "recorded".
- Diff the `.agyloop` tree hash printed by the script before/after; every dry-run row must be identical.
